<description>
Two identical declarations of `NodeId` make it ambiguous for static analysis tools such as IWYU which header should provide the symbol. Move the declaration into `net_types.h`.

The second commit fixes the `#include`s of the `net`, `net_types` and `node/eviction` modules, which the first commit touched, and adds the headers that other files previously received transitively from them.

A prerequisite for https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36808.
</description>
